hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; [ -f STATE.md ] && { echo '## STATE.md (auto-loaded)'; cat STATE.md; }; [ -f IDEAS.md ] && { echo '## IDEAS.md (open ideas, auto-loaded)'; head -n 12 IDEAS.md; }; [ -f CHANGELOG.md ] && { echo '## @global lines (CHANGELOG.md)'; grep -F '@global' CHANGELOG.md; echo '## Last 5 [FAIL] lines (CHANGELOG.md)'; grep -F '[FAIL]' CHANGELOG.md | tail -n 5; }; c=$(git log --since=24.hours --oneline 2>/dev/null | head -n 10); [ -n "$c" ] && { echo '## Commits of the last 24h (git log)'; echo "$c"; }; exit 0
